name: cand_fitb
setup: for g in MALE FEMALE; do ln -sf SMPLX_NEUTRAL.npz /workspace/HeadMovement/mamma/data/body_models/smplx_locked_head/smplx/SMPLX_$g.npz; done; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv

commands.name: fit_m06
commands.cmd: python -m dancecap mamma fit larissa_kadu_38_mono06 --tag m06

commands.name: fit_p06
commands.cmd: unset MAMMA_STATURE; export MAMMA_FREEZE_BETAS=1 MAMMA_INIT_BETAS=/workspace/HeadMovement/dancecap/work/larissa_kadu_38_mono06/mamma/pin_betas_ref.json; python -m dancecap mamma fit larissa_kadu_38_mono06 --tag p06

notes: mono4d fit B: MAMMA_MONO=1 single-camera ma_3d of phone 06, 58-62 s (120 grid frames)
m06: free betas held to the owner's statures (MAMMA_STATURE: stature + 2.5 cm sole) - the honest one-camera fit
p06 (optional): betas pinned to the 8-phone fit's (LEAKS shape from the multi-view fit) - diagnostic only
